newsitem.title: DUBAI: Qatar emir forms defence council.
newsitem.headline: Qatar emir forms defence council.

text.p: Qatar's Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani on Monday decreed the formation of a consultative defence council headed by himself, the official Qatar News Agency (QNA) reported.
The decree said the council would include Qatar's recently appointed crown prince, the emir's 18-year-old third son Sheikh Jassim bin Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani, as deputy head.

It would also include Prime Minister and Interior Minister Sheikh Abdullah bin Khalifa al-Thani, Foreign Minister Sheikh Hamad bin Jassim bin Jabr al-Thani, and Finance, Economy and Trade Minister Sheikh Mohammad bin Khalifa al-Thani, and the armed forces chief of staff.
The emir also named Hamad bin Ali al-Attiyah as armed forces chief of staff, QNA said.
The council would advise and consult with the emir on defence matters, the decree said.
